title: From bad to worse for Rams: Davante Adams to miss 6-10 weeks with ruptured hamstring

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: From bad to worse for Rams: Davante Adams to miss 6-10 weeks with ruptured hamstring
sources.description: Adams wasn't the only bad news L.A. got on Monday: Blake Grupe tore his ACL, Poona Ford ruptured his triceps, and Kobie Turner is projected to miss four to six weeks
